situations.title: 가족 대기 정보 제공
situations.tagline: Let me update you on how things are going.
situations.brief: 대기 중인 가족에게 진행 상황과 예상 시간을 제공하세요.
keyPhrases: He's being examined and is stable right now.
The tests take about an hour to come back.
I'll come find you as soon as we know more.

situations.title: 면회 규정 설명
situations.tagline: Let me explain how visiting works here.
situations.brief: 인원·시간 제한 등 면회 규정을 가족에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We allow one visitor at the bedside at a time.
You can go in for a few minutes shortly.
This helps us keep the area safe and calm.

situations.title: 보호자 신원·관계 확인
situations.tagline: May I ask your relationship to the patient?
situations.brief: 정보 제공 권한 확인을 위해 보호자의 신원·관계를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Can I confirm your name and how you're related?
Are you the patient's emergency contact?
This helps us know what we can share with you.

situations.title: 가족 질문 경청
situations.tagline: I know it's a lot — ask me anything you need.
situations.brief: 반복되는 가족의 질문을 인내심 있게 경청하고 응답하세요.
keyPhrases: That's a good question — let me explain again.
It's okay to ask as many times as you need.
I can see you're worried, and that's understandable.

situations.title: 환자 상태 기초 전달
situations.tagline: Here's where your dad stands right now.
situations.brief: 가족에게 환자의 기초 상태와 현재 진행 중인 검사를 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: He's stable, and his vital signs look good.
We're running some tests to find the cause.
There's no immediate danger right now.
goals: 현재 상태와 진행 검사를 쉽게 전달한다

situations.title: 검사 결과 대기 불안
situations.tagline: Waiting is the hardest part — let me sit with that.
situations.brief: 검사 결과를 기다리는 가족의 불확실성과 불안을 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I know not knowing is really hard.
I don't have the results yet, but I'll be honest when I do.
Is there anything I can get you while you wait?

situations.title: 가족 간 정보 상충
situations.tagline: Let's make sure everyone has the same information.
situations.brief: 가족 간 정보가 엇갈리는 상황에서 일관된 정보를 유지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me clarify what we actually know so far.
I understand you heard something different earlier.
It might help to designate one contact person.

situations.title: 치료 거부하는 가족
situations.tagline: Help me understand what's behind this decision.
situations.brief: 치료를 거부하는 가족과 환자 의사 사이의 충돌을 신중히 다루세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me what worries you about the treatment?
We also need to honor what your father would want.
Let's involve the doctor to talk this through.

situations.title: 소아 환자 부모 불안
situations.tagline: We're taking good care of her — you can stay close.
situations.brief: 처치 중인 소아 환자의 불안한 부모를 안심시키고 참여시키세요.
keyPhrases: You can hold her hand while we work.
Everything we're doing is to help her feel better.
Tell me what usually comforts her at home.

situations.title: 문화·종교 요청 반영
situations.tagline: We'll do our best to honor your family's wishes.
situations.brief: 임종·처치와 관련한 가족의 문화·종교적 요청을 존중하며 반영하세요.
keyPhrases: Please tell me what practices are important to you.
We can make space and time for prayer.
I'll coordinate with the team to honor that.

situations.title: 보호자 과잉 개입
situations.tagline: I know you want to help — let me guide how.
situations.brief: 처치를 방해할 만큼 과잉 개입하는 보호자를 존중하며 경계를 설정하세요.
keyPhrases: I can see how much you care about her.
For her safety, I need a little space to work.
You can help most by staying near her head and talking softly.

situations.title: 나쁜 소식 전 준비
situations.tagline: The doctor will be here soon — let's find a quiet space.
situations.brief: 나쁜 소식 전달 전 SPIKES 원칙에 따라 환경·정보를 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's step into a private room where we can talk.
What do you already understand about his condition?
Is there someone you'd like to have with you?

situations.title: 원거리 가족 전화 소통
situations.tagline: I'll walk you through everything over the phone.
situations.brief: 부재중인 원거리 가족에게 전화로 환자 상태를 전달하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm calling to update you on your mother's condition.
She's stable, and here's what's happening now.
You can call this number anytime for updates.

situations.title: 사망 고지 소통
situations.tagline: I'm so sorry — despite everything, he has died.
situations.brief: 가족에게 환자의 사망을 명확하고 연민 어린 말로 전하세요.
keyPhrases: I have very difficult news to share.
We did everything we could, but he has passed away.
Take all the time you need — I'm here with you.

situations.title: 소생 중 가족 입회
situations.tagline: You can be here with her — I'll stay by your side.
situations.brief: 소생술이 진행 중인 환자 곁에 입회한 가족을 지지하고 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: The team is doing everything possible for her.
I'll explain what's happening as we go.
Stand here with me — you can talk to her.

situations.title: 급성 상실 애도 지지
situations.tagline: There are no right words — I'm here with you.
situations.brief: 갑작스러운 죽음 직후 급성 상실을 겪는 가족을 애도 지지하세요.
keyPhrases: I can't imagine how hard this moment is.
It's okay to feel however you feel right now.
When you're ready, I can help with next steps.
goals: 준비될 때 다음 절차를 부드럽게 안내한다

situations.title: 연명치료 결정 회의
situations.tagline: Let's talk about what she would have wanted.
situations.brief: DNR 등 연명치료 목표를 가족과 함께 논의하고 합의하세요.
keyPhrases: Had she ever shared her wishes about this?
Our goal can be comfort rather than more machines.
There's no wrong choice — let's decide together.

situations.title: 장기기증 대화 연계
situations.tagline: There's a sensitive option I'd like to gently mention.
situations.brief: 뇌사 환자 가족에게 장기기증 대화를 민감하게 연계하세요.
keyPhrases: First, I'm so sorry for what you're facing.
When you're ready, a specialist can talk about donation.
There's no pressure — it's entirely your family's choice.
goals: 애도를 우선하며 기증 대화를 조심스럽게 연다

situations.title: 가족 분노·비난 대응
situations.tagline: I hear your anger — you have every right to it.
situations.brief: 상실 후 분노와 비난을 쏟는 유가족을 침착하게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: I understand you're angry, and that's okay.
I want to hear everything you need to say.
Let's sit down so I can explain what happened.

situations.title: 소아 사망 가족 지지
situations.tagline: I am so deeply sorry — I'm right here with you.
situations.brief: 아이를 잃은 가족의 극심한 애도를 지지하고 동반하세요.
keyPhrases: There are no words for this kind of loss.
You can hold her for as long as you need.
We can make a keepsake if you'd like, when you're ready.
